notes: Modified cash basis audit (FYE 9/30/2023). Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p5, Total column). Taxes 322,468 split from the General Fund (p15) and LB 840 Fund (p21) schedules; Intergovernmental 126,764, Charges for services 73,158 and Other 136,142 split from the fund schedules (pp15, 20, 21), each piece with its printed row label and exact sums. Governmental beginning cash is not printed (no prior-year column); fund balances 468,250 / 379,726 from p5; ending_cash = Cash 372,920 + Cash held by county treasurer 6,806 (p3). Business-type from the modified cash proprietary statement (pp9-10; accrual versions pp23-26 not used): capital contributions Federal grants 85,774 in business_type.other_financing; transfers net (17,454); net position 3,051,820 -> 2,950,380. Proprietary cash flows from the modified cash Statement of Cash Flows (pp11-12). Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (p1), since it includes capital assets. Detail: General Fund (pp15-18), Lottery (p19), Economic Development by program (p20), LB 840 (p21) and the Municipal Utilities Fund by department, modified cash (p22). The combined all-fund-types budget and actual schedule (pp13-14) is not recorded: its governmental lines combine funds and are less detailed than the fund schedules, and its utility lines are on a different basis than the department schedule (budget-basis governmental totals also include Airport 11,741 and Nursing Home Bonds 16,540 not in the fund statements).
